initial_conditions: Original Harbor base revision20 then height revision17, unchanged authoring/arrangement/materials/mesh/capsules/ground/self-contact, no pins or ellipsoids, fresh zero velocities. One prospectively authorized attempt per case on one exact identified source; no retry, tuning, third case, reset or continuation.

pass_criteria.strict_verdict: All-frame physical screens, completed-fit quality, complete capture and every diagnostic/attribution check must pass; final producer flags are consistency-only.

resource_caps.clock_scope: Before producer launch through numerical analysis, export, hashing, inspection and postbindings; no later calculation receives original-clock credit.
resource_caps.rss_measurement: Exact Darwin wait4 producer peak; sampled monitoring may stop early.
resource_caps.output_scope: Inputs, both preflights and every run path, counting duplicate logs/receipts per original path independently of public deduplication.

operations: Freeze exact source/input/producer/runner/evaluator and completed integrated gate identities before case authorization.
Execute base then height once; an operational/resource/binding failure stops, while arithmetic-complete quality failure permits only the declared height case.
Independently analyze all 181 retained boundary states per case without changing formulas, thresholds or workload.
Retain failures, accepted prefixes, raw counters and all frame lists; saved-state publication replay adds no physical execution.
expected_outcomes: Pass only when the complete fixed saved-state protocol satisfies every declared physical, completed-fit, diagnostic, attribution, capture and resource criterion. Initial open arrangement seams are excluded only from completed-fit seam/target criteria; transient strain/contact failures remain failures. Observations belong in source-qualified reports, never in these prospective criteria.
limits: Bounded static saved-state contact and cloth checks only; no complete CCD/contact contract, equilibrium, calibration, moving avatars, full garment/native/release gate or reference parity.
